rows.value: out-of-network plan allowance; member pays coinsurance plus any billed amount over the allowance (balance billing); lower annual maximum
rows.basis: how non-network dentists are paid
rows.quote: When you use an out-of-network dentist, you are responsible for the difference between the plan allowance and our payment plus the difference up to the submitted/approved charges.
rows.section: Section 3 How You Obtain Care — Plan allowance
rows.notes: Full paragraph (p. 13): "The plan allowance is the amount we allow for a specific procedure. When you use an in-network Delta Dental Federal Employees Dental Program provider, your out-of-pocket cost is limited to the difference between the plan allowance and our payment. When you use an out-of-network dentist, you are responsible for the difference between the plan allowance and our payment plus the difference up to the submitted/approved charges." Also pp. 12-13 (Out-of-network): "You may obtain care from any licensed dentist. If the dentist is not part of our network, benefits will be considered out-of-network. When you see a dentist who is outside of Delta Dental's participating network for the Federal Employees Dental Program, you will have a lower annual maximum benefit and we pay for services based on an out-of-network plan allowance. You are responsible for any difference between the plan payment and the amount submitted/approved." The dollar basis of the out-of-network allowance (fee schedule vs percentile) is not stated in readable pages; Section 9 Definitions unreadable.

rows.value: in-network: no charges above network allowance; out-of-network: coinsurance plus billed amount over plan allowance
rows.basis: Section 4 restatement
rows.quote: you will be responsible for your co-insurance percentage plus the billed amount over plan allowance.
rows.section: Section 4 — Out-of-Network Services
rows.notes: In-Network Services (p. 16): "You pay the coinsurance percentage of our network allowance for covered services. You are not responsible for charges above that allowance." Out-of-Network Services (p. 16): "If the dentist you use is not part of our network, benefits will be considered out-of-network. Because these providers are not part of our network, we pay for services rendered by an out-of-network provider based on an out-of-network plan allowance; you will be responsible for your co-insurance percentage plus the billed amount over plan allowance."
